repo.name: ethers.js
repo.description: Complete Ethereum library and wallet implementation in JavaScript.

readme.summary: Good high-level overview and feature list, but lacks any working code examples or practical usage guidance, relying heavily on external documentation links.
readme.top_issue: No quick-start code examples — a new user cannot see how to actually use the library without leaving to external docs.

common_complaints: Missing BNB Smart Chain support in providers
Transaction parsing failures on L2 chains due to invalid yParity values
Inability to retrieve fee data (maxFeePerGas/maxPriorityFeePerGas) on BNB chain
praise_themes: Issues do get resolved and closed
sentiment.summary: Moderate maintenance with selective responsiveness; maintainers address critical bugs but show slow engagement on feature requests and multi-chain compatibility gaps.

communication.summary: The maintainer responses are generally helpful and clear, showing patience with repeated questions. They provide technical depth where necessary but could be more detailed in some areas. New contributors are encouraged, making the communication style good overall.

concerns: 634 open issues with zero resolved in past 6 months
Zero merged pull requests in past 6 months
positive_signals: Single commit in February 2026 suggests minimal sporadic activity
maintenance.summary: Package is effectively abandoned with massive unresolved issue backlog and no maintenance activity for six months.

changelog.summary: The changelog is well-categorized but lacks clarity and completeness, with no breaking changes or migration guides.

project_metrics.description: Complete Ethereum library and wallet implementation in JavaScript.

concerns: High number of open issues and PRs
Limited contributor activity in the past six months
Community: Unable to get "maxFeePerGas" and "maxPriorityFeePerGas" for BNB chain

highlights: Some issue resolution and PR merges
